pos.personaBrief: Atalanta ranked mid-table for possession and liked to make things happen quickly, with top shot volume (Spielverlagerung, Scouted), dominating by danger rather than ball share.

pro.personaBrief: Vertical, fast attacks from the back three with later long balls and direct play (TFA 2022-24), but built from the back via the back three and De Roon/Freuler dropping.

est.personaBrief: Rehearsed 3-4-3 / 3-4-2-1 structure with defined roles, yet tight three-man combinations, a roaming Gomez and forwards dropping to link play.

lar.personaBrief: Heavy focus on wide areas through wing-backs and third-most crosses in Serie A (Spielverlagerung, TFA 2024), with no classic wingers and central trio up top.

blo.personaBrief: High, aggressive man-oriented pressing from the first pass, immediate counter-pressing, forwards pressing the build-up (Left Back Football, Yahoo 2024).

mar.personaBrief: Man-to-man marking is a core principle, with defenders like Djimsiti and Palomino tracking and shadowing opponents all over the pitch, only switching to zonal in the low block.

pla.personaBrief: Same 3-4-x and man-oriented identity every year, imposing the model on players, with some adaptation in later years (TFA 2021-22) but sticking with it versus Leverkusen and Inter.

res.personaBrief: Gasperini stressed how Atalanta won ('it's how we won'), playing proactive attacking football away from home and even in the final, not settling for draws.

sis.personaBrief: The collective system and the intense man-oriented work rate come first, with no divas, yet stars like Gomez and Ilicic got freedom in the final third.

jog.personaBrief: Exhausting high-intensity press, running wing-backs and aerial strength matter; even Gomez had to buy into the pressing game.

bas.personaBrief: Youth policy and development of Caldara, Conti, Gagliardini and Kessie, sold for profit; Gasperini played them on training merit regardless of age.

lid.personaBrief: Authoritarian, demanding coach with no divas in the roster, and a dressing-room clash with captain Gomez that ended in his exit.
